sources.note: Nothing on Kaje/Andarum phonology, stress or tone anywhere (a full-text search for stress/accent/tone/tonal/pitch co-occurring with Kaje/Andarum: none). Kaje content is morphosyntactic: Kaje has clause chaining, lacks realis/irrealis distinctions in medial verb morphology (fn. 142), has a reflex of the medial-verb enclitic =nda (ch. on -nda/-nde, citing 'Kaje [aod] (Brooks 2018)' = his ELAR Chini collection), and shares Goam-diagnostic lexemes; survey of Ramu documentation (p. ~71) lists for Kaje only 'a few transcribed audio recordings (Brooks 2018)'.
